reason: Case 3's fix is a missing-fallback / under-population defect on the credential *producer* path — username/password locals stay null because they are only filled from the inline `user:password@` segment gated by `pwdEndIdx > 0` and the fix adds `if (username/password == null && ...) username = parameters.get(USERNAME_KEY)` (its validated rule keys on `indexOf('#')` plus `$STAR = $PWD_IDX + 1` inside `if ($PWD_IDX > 0)`), so the buggy tree contains no unguarded method-call dereference of a possibly-null value — the covered buggy trees in cases 1/4 all contain such a dereference (`urlAddress.$M(...)`, `getServiceInfo(...).$M(...)`, `$SI.$M(...)`), meaning folding this in would require bolting on a disjoint, URLStrParser-specific structural branch rather than generalizing the existing 'possibly-null value dereferenced with no guard' invariant.
